text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса has done an incredible
job in her
first three years of the Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest racer—there isn't a
soul
around who thinks it's just a fantasy
anymore.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, it's time to depart for the rest of
the
world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Spe! Grass! Hasta luego! I'm off to
France!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Give 'em heck over there!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Good luck, El.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Qué?! Why are you saying bye, Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's not a race if you aren't there! After
all, it's my
goal to run in international
G1 races!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Tradition! Prestige—the peak of the
European
racing world!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I chuckle and tell her I was just kidding.
Of course
I'm going with her. I have to
lead Эль Кондор Паса
to success abroad
as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Go for it, El! I know you can do it!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It won't be easy. Your opponents will be
even
tougher than in the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: On top of that, she might be there. The French champion they say is the best in Europe.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: But El is stronger, right?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Well, to be honest...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: She's stronger than me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Are you gonna be okay? Isn't
that
frustrating?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It's not about being frustrated or not. I'm
just
callin' it like I see it.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Her feet never stop their pursuit!
They've carried
her across the finish line
in tons of big graded
races in Europe.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Does that mean you can't win?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Probably not. ♪
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...If I were the same El as last year, that
is.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You mean...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't messed up and actually went
overseas
right after the Japan Cup, I
would have lost.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I was just runnin' on talent alone back
then. But
not anymore!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Competing with you guys has really
honed my
strength.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: And I've got my trainer going with me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Not to mention, I've got cheering fans
whose
voices carry across the globe.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've picked up so many things in the last
year that
I can barely carry them all!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If I put all that together and do my very
best...
who knows what'll happen?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I know everyone is gonna be hella
excited to see
me take that and fight
with all I got!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: El!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
A one-winged condor... When El Condor
Pasa ran
off only talent, I could easily
see that name
sticking...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But things are different now. She's
sprouted a
spectacular pair of wings
from her battles these
past few years...
And now she's taking off for the
world.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Grass, Spe... I'm gonna get the whole
world
pumped!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've already thought of what I wanna say
when I
win.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: What is that, El?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: It's something my papa told me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
El cóndor puede volar más alto que
nadie.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: El cóndor pue...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: What does it mean?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: It means...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: The condor flies higher than anyone!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Speed isn't all that matters... There are
way more
awe-inspiring things out there,
and I'm gonna
show off all of 'em!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
